outcome.label: Accepted
outcome.reason: Bounded per-VM stream status, read-only observation, inherited hosted and sanitizer regressions, a positive native fixture CHARIN read with exact EOF and short-read observations, and a separate production no-provider fail-closed guest all passed.

compatibility_reference.profile: IBM z/OS 2.5 byte-oriented CHARIN stream I/O
guideXOS_adaptations: STREAM([name][,S|D]) is a read-only status/detail subset and is not IBM STREAM Command/C compatibility.
Provider errors and EOF are retained as separate observable states.
STREAM observation does not clear state.
SIGNAL ON NOTREADY delivery is not implemented.

stream_state.identity_key: Copied provider stable identity plus VM provider generation and nonzero provider identity generation.
stream_state.provider_replacement: Clears the table and advances provider generation.
stream_state.capacity_exhaustion: Fails before seek/read callback; no eviction.

transition_summary.full_read: READY unless provider reports EOF after the final returned byte, then EXHAUSTED.
transition_summary.short_read: Returns all obtained bytes and records SHORT_READ with requested/returned counts and EOF bit.
transition_summary.subsequent_eof: A later zero-byte EOF callback records EOF separately.
transition_summary.provider_error: Records ERROR and retains the provider status.
transition_summary.valid_seek: Sets READY and clears the earlier condition.
transition_summary.sequential_zero_length: Returns empty, makes no read/seek callback, preserves the sticky condition, and sets last operation/counts to ZERO_LENGTH_READ/0/0.
transition_summary.invalid_position_or_arguments: Reject before corrupting cursor or prior state; malformed CHARIN arguments are rejected before provider callbacks.
transition_summary.vm_teardown: Clears inline VM status; embedding remains owner of provider context and resources.

observation.detail_operation: D adds requested/returned/eof only for the last positive READ.
observation.provider_callbacks: Resolver only; never reads, seeks, inserts, or mutates status-table entries.
unsupported: OPEN, CLOSE, write, file discovery, or path interpretation

charin.positioning: Explicit start is one-based; CHARIN('sample',5) reads one byte at position five.
charin.binary: Length-bearing data preserves NUL and bytes 0x80-0xFF.
charin.zero_length: Explicit start plus zero length seeks without reading; sequential zero length does not call provider and retains the sticky condition.
charin.oversized_request: 16 MiB + 1 produces VM resource-limit failure before provider callbacks; the guest invocation terminates and cannot trap the runtime error with SIGNAL ON SYNTAX. Hosted tests verify prior state remains unchanged.

hosted_qualification.regina: NOT_RUN; no suitable Regina executable was available.

sanitizers.local_expected_result_cases: 196/196 per sanitizer run; differential comparison NOT_RUN because Regina was unavailable.

freestanding_amd64_builds.guarded_root_artifacts: 31/31 unchanged in each isolated build and QAC guest run.

native_guest_qualification.network: Disabled (-net none); disposable copied ESP and firmware used.

production_no_provider.result: STREAM()=UNAVAILABLE; CHARIN() failed closed through the REXX syntax trap; STREAM() remained UNAVAILABLE; recovery script ran.

results.oversized_request: VM resource limit exceeded after RX34_OVERSIZED_REQUEST_BEGIN; the follow-up recovery script then ran.

builtin_inventory.charin: Partial; registered byte-provider reads and bounded status are qualified, but production has no provider and compatibility remains a subset.
builtin_inventory.stream: Partial; read-only S/D status subset only.

remaining_compatibility_gaps: No production byte-stream provider or general filesystem integration.
No STREAM OPEN/CLOSE/write/line I/O or full IBM STREAM Command/C behavior.
No SIGNAL ON NOTREADY delivery, asynchronous waiting, or stream-error reset operation.
The native oversized request ends the current REXX invocation with a VM resource-limit error; post-error STREAM observation is available only in hosted assertions before teardown.
Regina comparison was not run because the executable was unavailable.
RX34 does not close RX31 native input or RX20 TIME(R) guest-acceptance gaps.
recommended_rx35_direction: Do not begin automatically. If prioritized, first specify a production provider contract and ownership/teardown policy, then evaluate language-level NOTREADY delivery and stream error recovery without adding unrestricted filesystem access.
